UI_Daydream_Sleep1: A new day. I'll remember waking up like this.
UI_Daydream_Sleep2: Slept alright. This moment feels worth holding onto.
UI_Daydream_Sleep3: Morning. If it all goes wrong, let me come back to here.
UI_Daydream_Sleep4: Another dawn survived. I won't forget this one.
UI_Daydream_Sleep5: Rested. Whatever happens today, this is where I start over.
UI_Daydream_Sleep6: I could get used to waking up in one piece.
UI_Daydream_Sleep7: New morning. Let this be the one I remember.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_zombie_1: I dreamt they got me. Teeth at my throat, the cold... God. It felt so real.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_zombie_2: A nightmare - dragged down by dead hands, biting, tearing. I can still feel it.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_zombie_3: They swarmed me in the dream. I felt myself go under. Never again.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_bite_1: The dream again: the bite, the fever, feeling myself turn. I woke up screaming inside.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_bite_2: I dreamt of the wound going bad. Watching my own hands grey over. Just a dream. Just a dream.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_infection_1: Fever dreams. I felt the sickness take me, felt myself slip away. It was so vivid.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_infection_2: In the nightmare the infection won. I remember dying slow. I won't let that happen.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_fire_1: I dreamt of burning. The heat, the smoke, no way out. I can still smell it.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_fire_2: Fire in the dream - I felt it eat through me. I jolted awake half expecting flames.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_cold_1: I dreamt of freezing to death, the cold creeping in until I couldn't move. Horrible.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_cold_2: The nightmare was all ice - shivering, then nothing. I need to stay warm.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_hunger_1: I dreamt of starving, of my body just giving out. I have to eat.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_hunger_2: Hollow, wasting away in the dream until the dark took me. I won't ignore my stomach again.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_thirst_1: I dreamt my throat closed up, dying of thirst in the heat. I need water.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_thirst_2: The nightmare was all dust and dry lungs. I can't neglect water like that.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_wound_1: I dreamt I bled out, the world going soft and far away. I felt it happen.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_wound_2: A dream of a wound that wouldn't close, of fading. It shook me awake.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_unknown_1: I had the worst nightmare - I dreamt I died out here. It felt real enough to taste.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_unknown_2: A terrible dream. I remember dying. I woke up glad to be breathing.
UI_Daydream_Nightmare_unknown_3: I dreamt this was all over, that I didn't make it. Never want to feel that again.
